podcast.body: Performed live on Saturday Night Live on January 26, 1980, this song had a "huge" and life-changing impact on an 11-year-old Dave Grohl, making him want to embrace strangeness in music. "When they performed Rock Lobster that night, Dave says, and this is a quote, I remember that moment like some people remember the Kennedy assassination."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was reportedly a favorite of Osama bin Laden, whose hard drives were examined after his death in May 2011. The discovery suggests his appreciation for the band's music. "He really loved them. Rock Lobster."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is from the band's self-titled debut album, released in 1979. "The B-52s and Rock Lobster from their self-tuttle debut album in 1979."
